notes.title: Release date shifted to January 9. Explanations.
notes.content:
Release date shifted to January 9. Explanations.

The game is ready; I spent November debugging it. 

The December release corresponds to an in-between sales period. 

[b]Arguments for the December 12 release:[/b]
- General buying euphoria.
- Few releases at that time.
- I'll have a very good first week of sales.

[b]Arguments against:[/b]
- I'd have a very bad second week of sales, because even if I do a discount, I've just learned that it won't correspond to a sale period. So I'd be evicted.
- The 3rd and 4th weeks are generally dead calm, with people more focused on their families.

This will allow me to compare Lucie's and CP's release since they will have the same release date two years apart.

[b]Also of note, I'm taking the opportunity to add content, sex scenes at night, moments that were lacking a bit of rhythm, etc. I'm polishing it up all month long. I'll be fine-tuning it throughout December[/b].

The content will be all the better for it. 

A complete game (which is rare) and immersive, fluid, problem-free.
